temporal_type_definitions.flow: Quantity occurring or accumulated during the observation period; additive across non-overlapping periods when conceptually appropriate.
temporal_type_definitions.stock: Level existing at a point in time or representing an outstanding stock; not additive through time.
temporal_type_definitions.period_average: Explicit average or mean over the observation period.
temporal_type_definitions.period_statistic: Non-additive period level, index, median, modeled level, scenario value, or other period statistic.
temporal_type_definitions.derived_ratio: Ratio, rate, share, or yield; generally non-additive and preferably recomputed from components when available.
temporal_type_definitions.growth_change: Growth or change measure derived across observations; generally recomputed from underlying levels when changing frequency.
temporal_type_definitions.rolling_window: Observation represents an overlapping rolling window; adjacent observations should not be mechanically summed.
temporal_type_definitions.cumulative: Cumulative-to-date measure; adjacent cumulative observations should not be summed.
temporal_type_definitions.metadata_or_assumption: Uncertainty measure, flag, diagnostic count, source metadata, or fixed modeling assumption for which time aggregation is not economically meaningful.

ca_homeowners_avg_written_premium_real.reason: Inflation-adjusted annual average written premium per exposure. Deflation preserves the non-additive ratio interpretation.

acs_implied_average_mortgage_balance_pro.reason: Cross-sectional implied average outstanding mortgage balance per mortgaged owner unit. It is a non-additive average balance, not an average over successive periods.

method: Explicit per-variable mapping. Preserve original unit, all numerical observations, source-specific frequency conversion rules, source provenance and geography. Apply only label aliases recorded in the reference workbook. Add configured variables through explicit review of their existing definitions and transformations.
unit_simplification_caveat: The workbook's generic 0-to-1 assumption for fraction/share/proportion does not describe growth/change variables. Renaming fraction to share changes no numbers and imposes no range restriction; growth can be negative or above one. Percent, ratio, percentage_points, index base, annualization, dollar scale and constant-dollar labels remain distinct.
monetary_basis_note: Retain monetary basis explicitly encoded by original units; plain USD labels use not_specified_in_unit, so source-specific methodological notes remain authoritative. Inflation-adjusted USD/year retains inflation_adjusted_unspecified_base and its original unit.

redfin_zip_median_days_on_market_yoy_day.reason: Provider successor exports report median days-on-market YoY as a change in days. Keep it distinct from the legacy percent field and calculated percent growth. No unit conversion or observation fabrication.
